in_marathi.name: Elita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Elita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Elita is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Elita', which means 'Goddess of Light'. In Hindu mythology, Elita is the goddess of knowledge, wisdom, and the sun. She is often depicted holding a lotus flower or a book, symbolizing knowledge and learning.
